title: External MCP Gateway
description: Lets external AI hosts (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT) call AionUi's IDE tools through a token-protected loopback endpoint. Disabled by default; only reachable from this machine (127.0.0.1).
internalHint: AionUi's built-in AI already uses MTUI, Terminal and IDE tools directly. Enable this gateway only for other local apps or Web AI.
enableHint: When on, the loopback HTTP+SSE server starts and external hosts can connect with the bearer token below.
portHint: Pick any free port between 1024 and 65535. Default 47821.

rootPath.label: Workspace folder
rootPath.hint: External sessions are pinned to this folder. The bootstrap response reports it as the workspace root.
rootPath.empty: No folder selected — pick one before enabling the gateway.

token.label: Bearer token
token.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the token? Every external client will lose its connection and must paste the new token.
token.missing: No token yet — enable the gateway to mint one.

dangerous.label: Allow dangerous tools
dangerous.hint: Off by default. When on, external hosts can call ide_command (shell), team_write_file (full-file write), db_* (SQL), and ide_memory_set_secret.

mcpJson.title: Claude Desktop / Cursor mcp.json snippet
mcpJson.hint: Paste this into your client's MCP config, then restart the client.

web.title: Web AI access
web.description: Publish a temporary HTTPS MCP endpoint for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other Web AI connectors.
web.stopped: Web AI session stopped and all public tokens were revoked.
web.startFailed: Could not start Web AI access.
web.timeout: Timed out waiting for the tunnel to start. Check your network, or restart the app and try again.
web.securityHint: Web Access exposes the same in-app IDE tools (search, read, terminal, edit, etc.) as your local agent — only through a Cloudflare quick tunnel. The session stays open until you disable it.
web.rotateToReveal: Rotate the Web session to reveal a new token
web.debugHint: For Web AIs without an MCP connector, create a short-lived read-only bootstrap URL.
web.debugLimits: Browser-friendly read-only links. Active until you revoke them or disable Web Access.
web.tokenLifetime: The token stays valid until you disable Web Access or rotate it.

progress.waitingTunnelUrl: Waiting for Cloudflare to assign a public URL (~10–20 s)…

auth.title: Authentication mode
auth.description: Choose how Web AI clients authenticate to the public tunnel. The local Bearer token always keeps working for Claude Desktop / Cursor.

modeHint.bearer: Classic short-lived Bearer token. Paste it into the client's Authorization header.
modeHint.oauth: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Works with the ChatGPT MCP connector — clients register and authorize themselves.
modeHint.mixed: Accept either a valid OAuth access token or the Bearer token.
modeHint.none: No authentication — every request is accepted. Use only for a throwaway local demo behind the tunnel.

auth.ttlHint: How long a bootstrapped session stays valid without activity. Applies to new sessions.

oauth.title: Registered OAuth clients
oauth.hint: Clients that completed the OAuth flow. Revoking a client invalidates all of its tokens immediately.
oauth.empty: No OAuth clients have registered yet.
oauth.revokeConfirm: This client and all of its tokens will be revoked immediately. It must register and authorize again to reconnect.

tools.title: Per-tool permissions
tools.hint: Allow or deny individual tools. 'Default' follows the dangerous-tools setting (base tools allowed, dangerous tools gated).

errors.portInUse: Port is already in use. Pick a different port.

mode.label: Remote Access Mode
mode.quickHint: Temporary test URL. The app starts a Quick Tunnel and shows a throwaway HTTPS URL — good for a quick test, not for a persistent connector.
mode.setupHint: Use your own stable public URL. Point a Cloudflare Named Tunnel, VPS reverse proxy, Tailscale Funnel, or ngrok custom domain at this machine and paste the URL here.

quick.warning: This URL is temporary and may change after you restart the app or the tunnel. Not recommended for a long-lived ChatGPT/Grok MCP connector — use Setup mode with your own stable URL for that.

setup.intro: Persistent while your DNS/tunnel points to this machine. The app does not manage any tunnel in this mode — it only stores your URLs and generates copyable endpoints.
setup.unsupportedProtocol: Only http:// and https:// are supported.
setup.pathNotAllowed: Enter the origin only (no path), e.g. https://mcp.example.online
setup.insecureHttpWarning: Plain http:// to a public host sends tokens in clear text. Prefer https://.
setup.trycloudflareWarning: This looks like a temporary Quick Tunnel URL. It may change after restart.
setup.connectorUpdateWarning: MCP clients may need to update or recreate their connector.
setup.localTargetHint: Point your public tunnel/reverse proxy to the local MCP service: {{target}}
setup.localWebuiTargetHint: Point your public tunnel/reverse proxy to the local WebUI service: {{target}}
setup.configurationNeeded: Enter and save a valid Stable MCP Base URL to generate endpoints.
